description: List Morpho Blue markets, filterable by chain, loan token and collateral token. Paginate by passing back `cursor` until it is null.

chain_ids.description: Filter by chain ids. Required when `loan_tokens` or `collateral_tokens` is provided. Omit to list markets on every chain the API exposes.

collateral_tokens.description: Filter by collateral token addresses. Combine with chain_ids; lowercase input is checksummed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page response.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

listed.description: Filter by listing status. When true, returns only markets surfaced by the app trust layer; when false, only unlisted markets. Omit to return both.

loan_tokens.description: Filter by loan token addresses. Combine with chain_ids; lowercase input is checksummed.

sort_by.description: Sort field for cursor pagination. Markets without a value for the sort field (for example, unpriced markets on USD sorts) come last in both directions.

name: morpho_query_markets

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there is none.

borrow_apy.description: Native borrow APY as a decimal fraction (0.05 = 5%), excluding rewards.

chain_id.description: Chain id where the market exists.

collateral_token.description: Collateral token address. The zero address for idle markets.

liquidity_assets.description: Borrowable liquidity (supplied minus borrowed assets, floored at zero), in loan-token units.

liquidity_assets_usd.description: USD value of borrowable liquidity, null when the loan token price is unavailable.

market_id.description: Onchain Morpho Blue market id, unique per chain.

outstanding_loans.description: Total borrowed assets, in loan-token units.

outstanding_loans_usd.description: USD value of total borrowed assets, null when the loan token price is unavailable.

supply_apy.description: Native supply APY as a decimal fraction (0.05 = 5%), excluding rewards.

supply_assets.description: Total supplied assets, in loan-token units.

supply_assets_usd.description: USD value of total supplied assets, null when the loan token price is unavailable.
